newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Leases acquires S.African mine land.
newsitem.headline: Rand Leases acquires S.African mine land.

text.p: Rand Leases Property Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired certain properties of three South African gold mines and an unlisted mining company to undertake further township and property developments.

The company said it will acquire various properties from Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd, East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd, the entire share capital of First Wesgold Mining (Pty) Ltd and certain assets and liabilities of Stilfontein Gold Mining Company Ltd.
The transaction is worth around 66.71 million rand.

"The projects to be undertaken by Rand Leases Property will include the development of low cost housing, via joint ventures with various contruction companies, medium income housing and industrial and commercial township and property developments," the company said.
It said the cash portion of the assets acquired from Stilfontein and the proceeds from the royalty disposal will be used to fund initial developments.
Rand Leases said the properties and assets it will acquire were all excess to the mining needs of the mines.
